inspected_function_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.course_has_baseline(p_path_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.learning_paths WHERE id=p_path_id AND is_published); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_lesson_available(p_lesson_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(auth.uid() is not null and public.phase1_lesson_is_available(p_lesson_id, auth.uid()), false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, role) values (new.id, 'USER');
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase1_lesson_is_available(p_lesson_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.lessons t join public.chapters c on c.id=t.chapter_id join public.learning_paths p on p.id=c.learning_path_id
 where t.id=p_lesson_id and t.is_published and c.is_published and p.is_published and (
 exists(select 1 from public.lesson_progress lp where lp.user_id=p_user_id and lp.lesson_id=t.id and lp.status='COMPLETED') or (
 not exists(
 select 1 from public.lessons prior join public.chapters pc on pc.id=prior.chapter_id
 left join public.lesson_progress lp on lp.lesson_id=prior.id and lp.user_id=p_user_id
 where pc.learning_path_id=p.id and pc.is_published and pc.is_required and prior.is_published and prior.is_required
 and (pc.position,prior.position)<(c.position,t.position) and lp.status is distinct from 'COMPLETED'))));
$function$

views.definition:
SELECT e.id,
    e.lesson_id,
    e.type,
    e.title,
    e.prompt,
    e.starter_code,
    e.public_config,
    e."position",
    e.is_required
   FROM exercises e
     JOIN lessons lesson ON lesson.id = e.lesson_id
     JOIN chapters chapter ON chapter.id = lesson.chapter_id
     JOIN learning_paths path ON path.id = chapter.learning_path_id
  WHERE e.is_published AND lesson.is_published AND chapter.is_published AND path.is_published AND current_user_lesson_available(e.lesson_id);

SELECT test.id,
    test.exercise_id,
    test.stdin,
    test.expected_output,
    test.weight,
    test."position"
   FROM test_cases test
     JOIN exercises exercise ON exercise.id = test.exercise_id
     JOIN lessons lesson ON lesson.id = exercise.lesson_id
     JOIN chapters chapter ON chapter.id = lesson.chapter_id
     JOIN learning_paths path ON path.id = chapter.learning_path_id
  WHERE NOT test.is_hidden AND exercise.is_published AND lesson.is_published AND chapter.is_published AND path.is_published AND current_user_lesson_available(exercise.lesson_id);

lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.acknowledge_material_read(p_lesson_id uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/acknowledge_material_read`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.consume_code_request_quota(p_kind text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/consume_code_request_quota`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.current_user_has_active_assessment()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/current_user_has_active_assessment`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.current_user_lesson_available(p_lesson_id uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/current_user_lesson_available`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.phase1_start_lesson(p_lesson_id uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/phase1_start_lesson`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.start_assessment_session(p_assessment_id uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/start_assessment_session`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
